messages.subject: Policy on repeat students
parts:
Hi

My Name is Vijay Barve and I participated in GSoC 2012 [http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/proposal/review/google/gsoc2012/vijaybarve/8002] with rOpenSci mentors Scott Chamberlain, Carl Boettiger and Karthik Ram. I worked on two packages rgbif and rvertnet to access data from two important Biodiversity data repositories and some visualization. But there is a lot that can be done in this field and the user base is rapidly increasing.   

Now I am hoping to work on next logical step of this workflow, data validation and visualizations. 

Before I approach mentors with my idea, I wanted to make sure that R-project allows repeat students for GSoC. I know Google allows repeat students and most organisations do. 

Regards,

Vijay Barve
